title: 2.3.5 Groups Sandbox
description: Groups let you treat many sprites as one. Create, configure, spawn into, and clean up a Group.

steps.title: Make a Group
steps.instructions: let stars = new Group(); — a Group is a sprite factory + a container.
hints: Open the q5play docs Groups chapter on the right (or run /docs/q5play/groups) for the API.

steps.title: Set defaults on the Group
steps.instructions: stars.color = 'yellow'; stars.diameter = 10; — every sprite added to the group starts with these.
hints: Set defaults once on the Group rather than per-sprite. Check the Groups docs section on defaults.

steps.title: Spawn sprites into the Group
steps.instructions: In draw(), every so often call new stars.Sprite(randomX, 0) — note capital-S Sprite on the group.
hints: The q5play docs has examples of timed spawning. Look for the frameCount % N === 0 idiom.

steps.title: Remove sprites that leave the screen
steps.instructions: Iterate the group and remove any sprite past the bottom of the canvas. Otherwise your sketch slows to a crawl.
hints: Iterating a Group while removing trips a subtle bug. The Groups docs has a section on safe removal.

requirements.title: Spawn into the Group
requirements.description: Use groupName.Sprite(...) to spawn a sprite in the group

requirements.title: Group default
requirements.description: Set a property on the Group itself (e.g. .color, .diameter)
